name: classifier
instructions:
Classify the customer's intent from their message to the digital bank support chat.

If the message mentions multiple issues, pick the PRIMARY one the customer is focused on.

Critical distinctions for similar categories:
- 'why_verify_identity': asking WHY verification is required/questioning reason (e.g., 'Do I have to verify')
- 'verify_my_identity': customer NEEDS to verify, must complete process (e.g., 'I need to verify')
- 'visa_or_mastercard': asking what card TYPES are supported (e.g., 'Do you support Visa')
- 'get_physical_card': received PIN, has activated card, wants physical card to use it
- 'getting_spare_card': wants additional/duplicate card (e.g., 'Is a new card free')
- 'order_physical_card': explicitly ordering, asking about fees/process for physical card
- 'card_delivery_estimate': asking specifically when/how card will arrive
- 'declined_transfer': transfer between accounts was rejected
- 'declined_card_payment': payment at merchant/store was rejected  
- 'cancel_transfer': wants to undo/stop a transfer already sent
- 'request_refund': asking for refund/reversal of charge
- 'pending_transfer': asking when pending transfer will arrive
- 'pending_card_payment': asking when pending card payment will post
- 'transfer_into_account': how to send money TO this account
- 'topping_up_by_card': how to use card to add funds TO this account
- 'card_payment_not_recognised': disputes charge saying they didn't make it
- 'extra_charge_on_statement': unexpected charge on statement
- 'verify_top_up': verifying a top-up was successful
- 'verify_source_of_funds': proving where money comes from

criteria.activate_my_card: Customer wants to activate or enable their card for first use. Example: 'How do I activate my card'
criteria.age_limit: Questions about age restrictions or minimum age requirements. Example: 'Is there an age limit'
criteria.apple_pay_or_google_pay: Question about using Apple Pay, Google Pay, or similar digital wallets. Example: 'Can I use Google Pay'
criteria.atm_support: Issues finding or using ATMs, ATM not accepting card, or asking about ATM locations. Example: 'Where are the ATMs'
criteria.automatic_top_up: Setting up or asking about automatic top-up to the account. Example: 'Can I set up automatic top-up'
criteria.balance_not_updated_after_bank_transfer: Balance hasn't been updated after a bank transfer in. Example: 'My balance didn't update after transfer'
criteria.balance_not_updated_after_cheque_or_cash: Balance hasn't been updated after depositing cheque or cash. Example: 'Deposited cash but balance unchanged'
criteria.beneficiary_not_allowed: Issue about beneficiary being blocked or not allowed for transfer. Example: 'Beneficiary not allowed'
criteria.cancel_transfer: Customer wants to stop or undo a transfer they already sent. Example: 'I want to cancel that transfer' OR 'I want to revert this transaction'
criteria.card_about_to_expire: Card is expiring soon and needs renewal. Example: 'My card is about to expire'
criteria.card_acceptance: Asking whether a specific card type is accepted somewhere. Example: 'Are Mastercards accepted here'
criteria.card_arrival: Customer's card has already arrived. Example: 'My card arrived'
criteria.card_delivery_estimate: Asking when a card will be delivered. Example: 'When will my card arrive' OR 'How will I get my card'
criteria.card_linking: Linking a new card to the account or app. Example: 'How do I link my card'
criteria.card_not_working: Card is not working properly, won't read, or won't be accepted. Example: 'My card isn't working'
criteria.card_payment_fee_charged: Fee was charged for making a card payment. Example: 'Why was there a fee for my payment'
criteria.card_payment_not_recognised: Customer disputes they made this payment. They didn't buy it. Example: 'I have a charge for something I didn't buy'
criteria.card_payment_wrong_exchange_rate: Wrong exchange rate applied to card payment. Example: 'Wrong exchange rate on my card payment'
criteria.card_swallowed: ATM or card reader swallowed/kept the card. Example: 'The ATM swallowed my card'
criteria.cash_withdrawal_charge: Charge or fee applied to cash withdrawal. Example: 'Why was there a fee for withdrawing cash'
criteria.cash_withdrawal_not_recognised: Customer doesn't recognize this cash withdrawal charge. Example: 'I don't recognize this withdrawal charge'
criteria.change_pin: Customer wants to change their PIN code. Example: 'How do I change my PIN'
criteria.compromised_card: Card has been compromised, hacked, or breached. Example: 'My card was hacked'
criteria.contactless_not_working: Contactless/tap payment not working. Example: 'Contactless payment won't work'
criteria.country_support: Question about support in a specific country. Example: 'Do you support US'
criteria.declined_card_payment: Card payment was declined/rejected when trying to pay at a store or online. Example: 'My card keeps getting declined when I try to buy'
criteria.declined_cash_withdrawal: Cash withdrawal was declined/rejected at ATM. Example: 'ATM declined my cash withdrawal'
criteria.declined_transfer: Transfer to another account was declined/rejected. Example: 'My transfer was declined' OR 'Why do you keep denying my transfers'
criteria.direct_debit_payment_not_recognised: Customer doesn't recognize or disputes a direct debit charge. Example: 'How can I dispute a debit transaction'
criteria.disposable_card_limits: Question about limits on disposable/temporary cards. Example: 'What are the limits on disposable cards'
criteria.edit_personal_details: Customer wants to update their account details, name, address, etc. Example: 'How do I update my details'
criteria.exchange_charge: Charge or fee applied for currency exchange. Example: 'Why was there a charge for exchange'
criteria.exchange_rate: Question about exchange rates or how rates are calculated. Example: 'What's your exchange rate'
criteria.exchange_via_app: Performing currency exchange through the app. Example: 'How do I exchange currency'
criteria.extra_charge_on_statement: Unexpected charge on account statement that customer didn't authorize. Example: 'I have an unexpected charge on my statement'
criteria.failed_transfer: Transfer failed to complete. Example: 'My transfer failed'
criteria.fiat_currency_support: Question about which fiat currencies are supported. Example: 'What currencies do you support'
criteria.get_disposable_virtual_card: Requesting a temporary/disposable virtual card. Example: 'Can I get a temporary card'
criteria.get_physical_card: Requesting physical card to use after activation (has PIN). Example: 'I haven't received my PIN' OR 'When will I get my card'
criteria.getting_spare_card: Requesting additional/duplicate/spare physical card. Example: 'Is a new card free' OR 'Can I get a spare card' OR 'Can I get a duplicate card'
criteria.getting_virtual_card: Getting a virtual/digital card number. Example: 'How do I get a virtual card'
criteria.lost_or_stolen_card: Card was lost or stolen. Example: 'My card was stolen'
criteria.lost_or_stolen_phone: Phone was lost or stolen. Example: 'My phone was stolen'
criteria.order_physical_card: Explicitly ordering a physical card, asking about fees/process. Example: 'I need a physical card. What are the fees'
criteria.passcode_forgotten: Customer forgot their passcode/password. Example: 'I forgot my password'
criteria.pending_card_payment: Card payment is pending/waiting to complete. Example: 'When will my card payment post'
criteria.pending_cash_withdrawal: Cash withdrawal from ATM is pending/waiting to complete. Example: 'My ATM withdrawal is still pending'
criteria.pending_top_up: Top-up is pending/waiting to complete. Example: 'My top-up is still pending'
criteria.pending_transfer: Transfer to another account is pending/waiting to complete. Example: 'When will my transfer arrive' OR 'How long does transfer take'
criteria.pin_blocked: PIN is blocked after too many wrong attempts. Example: 'My PIN is blocked'
criteria.receiving_money: Questions about receiving money/funds from others. Example: 'Can others send me money'
criteria.Refund_not_showing_up: Refund hasn't appeared in account. Example: 'My refund still hasn't appeared'
criteria.request_refund: Customer is requesting a refund for a transaction. Example: 'I want a refund' OR 'Can you refund my charge'
criteria.reverted_card_payment?: Card payment was reverted/reversed. Example: 'My card payment was reversed'
criteria.supported_cards_and_currencies: What card types and currencies are supported. Example: 'What payment methods do you accept'
criteria.terminate_account: Customer wants to close/terminate the account. Example: 'I want to close my account'
criteria.top_up_by_bank_transfer_charge: Charge for top-up via bank transfer. Example: 'Is there a fee for bank transfer top-up'
criteria.top_up_by_card_charge: Charge for top-up via credit/debit card. Example: 'Is there a fee to top-up by card'
criteria.top_up_by_cash_or_cheque: Top-up with cash or cheque. Example: 'Can I top-up with cash'
criteria.top_up_failed: Top-up to account failed to complete. Example: 'My top-up failed' OR 'I'm not sure if my top-up went through'
criteria.top_up_limits: Question about limits on how much can be topped up. Example: 'What's the limit for top-ups'
criteria.top_up_reverted: Top-up was reverted/reversed. Example: 'My top-up was reversed'
criteria.topping_up_by_card: How to add funds to account using a credit/debit card. Example: 'How do I top-up using my card' OR 'Can I transfer money using my credit card'
criteria.transaction_charged_twice: Transaction was charged twice by mistake. Example: 'I was charged twice'
criteria.transfer_fee_charged: Fee charged for making a transfer. Example: 'Why was there a fee for my transfer'
criteria.transfer_into_account: How to transfer/send money TO this account from outside. Example: 'How do I transfer money in' OR 'Can someone send me money using a transfer'
criteria.transfer_not_received_by_recipient: Recipient didn't receive the transfer. Example: 'My friend hasn't received the transfer yet'
criteria.transfer_timing: Question about how long transfers take. Example: 'How long do transfers take'
criteria.unable_to_verify_identity: Can't complete identity verification process. Example: 'I can't verify my identity'
criteria.verify_my_identity: Customer needs to verify their identity. Example: 'I need to verify my identity'
criteria.verify_source_of_funds: Customer needs to verify where money came from. Example: 'I need to verify source of funds'
criteria.verify_top_up: Verifying a top-up transaction. Example: 'Can you verify my top-up'
criteria.virtual_card_not_working: Virtual card is not working. Example: 'My virtual card isn't working'
criteria.visa_or_mastercard: Asking what card TYPES are supported (Visa, Mastercard, etc). Example: 'Do you support Visa' OR 'I need a Visa card'
criteria.why_verify_identity: Asking WHY identity verification is required, questioning the reason. Example: 'Why do I have to verify' OR 'Do I have to verify who I am'
criteria.wrong_amount_of_cash_received: Received wrong amount of cash from ATM. Example: 'The ATM gave me wrong amount'
criteria.wrong_exchange_rate_for_cash_withdrawal: Wrong exchange rate on cash withdrawal. Example: 'The exchange rate for my withdrawal was too high'
